# OpenDDIL Edge SDK (.NET) — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org/

> OpenDDIL Edge SDK for .NET manages the local SQLite Outbox on Edge devices.
> Events are serialized as Protobuf binaries and spooled locally for eventual flush to HQ.

## Project Purpose
Client-side SDK for DDIL environments. All writes go to a local SQLite Outbox.
No network calls are made during event creation — the Relay handles sync.

## Architecture
- Write Path: UI → InventoryOperations → OutboxManager → SQLite Outbox → Relay → Redpanda
- Read Path: ElectricSQL → SQLite Read-Cache → UI (handled separately)
- Events are wrapped in CloudEvent envelopes (from openddil-contracts)
- Payload is serialized Protobuf binary (BLOB in SQLite)

## Key Files
- src/OpenDdilOutboxManager.cs: Core Outbox manager (enqueue, get pending, mark processed).
- src/InventoryOperations.cs: High-level AllocateInventory() wrapper for UI developers.
- src/OutboxRelayService.cs: BackgroundService that flushes Outbox to Redpanda (exponential backoff, Zstd compression).
- sql/outbox_schema.sql: SQLite schema for outbox_events table.

## Dependencies
- Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: SQLite access.
- Google.Protobuf: Protobuf serialization.
- Confluent.Kafka: Kafka/Redpanda producer (idempotent, Zstd compression).
- Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting: BackgroundService for the Relay.
- Generated C# classes from openddil-contracts (make csharp).

## Outbox Table Schema
- id: TEXT PRIMARY KEY (UUID v4)
- event_type: TEXT NOT NULL (CloudEvent type URI)
- payload_bytes: BLOB NOT NULL (serialized CloudEvent Protobuf)
- created_at: TEXT NOT NULL (ISO 8601 UTC)
- is_processed: INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 (0=pending, 1=flushed)
